title: Class balance
text:
Every class was measured fighting a level-20 monster with the same gear. Three were out of line.

⬆️ Barbarian: builds rage almost twice as fast from its own swings. It was starved of rage and dealt the least damage of every class, even less than the Mender. Its damage is now in line with the other damage classes
⬆️ Bulwark: its attacks deal about a third less damage, but cause exactly the same threat. As a tank it was out-damaging the Arcanist and the Barbarian
⬆️ Arcanist: damage spells cost 25% less mana. It used to run dry a third of the way into a long fight
